native_transport: Per-client in-process bufconn gRPC only; CommandServer.Start is not called during native initialization; no command.sock or listening port created.
storage_compatibility: Fixed accidental Beta package-wide replacement of HUKS alias and AES-GCM AAD. Canonical namespace independent of bundle; authenticated read compatibility for exact0.2.38/39 Beta pair; no generation on decrypt, key deletion or plaintext fallback. Existing envelope schema/algorithm/parameters retained. prepare-beta.ps1 modifies explicit identity fields only and checks cipher/store byte parity.
app_checkpoint_status: Published from public source tag v0.90.23; checkpoint base f2960799
channel_policy: Bundled upstream core determines channel. Stable core 1.14.4 and prerelease core 1.15.0-alpha.13 are retained; app version does not certify device stability or a new upstream core update.
source_variant: Stable public app tree with matching 1.14.4 adaptation and complete source ZIP

removed: Go VPN diagnostic recorder and lifecycle samples
ETS recorder calls and periodic samples
USB watcher script, tests and guide
preserved: VPN health checks and automatic recovery

ui: Log title, clear action, search and cards share one native List. Level menu uses ListItemGroup sticky Header below statusbar. Scroll back to top restores title/search. Final rows clear floating dock. Card keys combine content and index; no-match filter state is explicit. Existing native transparent material remains.
network_change: Default underlay identity uses netId, bearer, interface and normalized addresses. DNS-only changes reset connections without discarding TUN. Real IPv6 route identity replacement rebuilds safely. Normal network/policy waits do not consume true-start failure budget; unknown policy preserves usable old TUN, and Wi-Fi-off/default-cellular ignores stale Wi-Fi association. Existing health cadence supplements missed events; manual stop stays authoritative. Unknown VPN ownership waits conservatively.

validation.known_baseline_failures: Two old navigation-drag fixture failures missing selectNavigation, reproduced with pre-change source

device_validation.prior_wifi_observation: A real HTTPS page loaded with VPN enabled on the prior app. HTTP 204 blank page alone is not a failure. This does not prove the old intermittent Wi-Fi issue is fixed.
pending: actual log scrolling and material rendering

validation_limit: Related tests and local package checks are complete, not full-suite or signed-device certification. No claim of eliminating all VPN drops or IPv6/WebRTC leaks. HAP hashes describe unsigned outputs and change on signing.
privacy: No signing materials, subscriptions, node secrets or private device reports belong in source/release attachments.
